name: jev-toolkit-compiler
description: Claude Code mods built on a judgement model (currently TypeSafe Jev, optional): compact/clear advice, a searchable log of past sessions, and an experimental replacement of the compaction summary.

plugins.name: jev-context
plugins.description: Advises when a big context is worth compacting or clearing, and searches a log of past sessions. Advice only; shares one judge request with jev-router when both are installed. Needs the jev-toolkit-compiler and jev-toolkit-usage Python packages installed.

plugins.name: jev-context-replace
plugins.description: Instead of a model-written compaction summary, keeps a local outline and fetches details from the jev-context log. One click to turn on or off. Off by default. Needs jev-context.
